what_it_shows: Plaid Link opening pane: 'WonderWallet uses Plaid to connect your accounts', phone-number field for returning-user login, Terms/Privacy consent, Continue / Continue as guest
Plaid Link 'Select your institution' step: search box over 11,000+ institutions plus grid of popular bank tiles, with 3-segment progress bar
Plaid Link OAuth handoff screen: 'Log into Gingham Bank' interstitial explaining redirect to the bank, data-sharing disclosure, 'Continue to log in' CTA
Bank-side credential entry during Link: Gingham Bank branded username/password form with Face ID affordance and Sign In button
Plaid Link 'Select accounts' step: checkbox list of checking/savings accounts with masked numbers and balances, scoped-sharing copy, Continue button
Plaid Link success terminal state: checkmark, 'Your account was successfully connected to WonderWallet', Continue button returning to the app

Copilot onboarding 'Select your institution' modal: grid of top institutions (Chase, BofA, Capital One, Amex, PNC, Fidelity, Apple, Venmo), 'Link other institutions through Plaid' and non-Plaid fallback link
Copilot desktop Categories screen: hierarchical category/subcategory list with spent-vs-budget bars, Rebalance and add-category actions, per-category detail panel with monthly history and key metrics
Lunch Money CSV/PDF import 'Upload your files' dialog: target-account dropdown, drag-and-drop zone (10,000 row limit), attached file chip, View Raw Data and 'Process 210 rows' actions
Lunch Money 'Match CSV columns' step: per-column dropdown mapping (Date/Payee/Category/Amount, required fields marked, 'Do not import' option) over a preview of parsed rows
YNAB File Import: account register with File Import button and modal listing recommended formats (OFX/QFX, supported QIF/CSV) plus automatic duplicate-matching note and Choose File CTA
Quicken Simplifi Transaction detail dialog with Attachments section highlighted (Upload control) alongside payee/amount/category/tags fields, Split, exclude-from toggles, and Update/Delete actions
Quicken Simplifi first-run welcome card: 'Welcome to Simplifi — you're on your way to taking control of your finances' with Get started button (pre-data state)
Quicken Simplifi onboarding empty state: 'Add accounts to see all your finances in one place' with single Add Account CTA before any data exists
Quicken Simplifi add-account consent screen: 'Quicken Simplifi uses Intuit to connect' with expandable data-access/privacy/control disclosures and Continue button (aggregator consent pattern)

Quicken Simplifi Settings > Categories & tags page: settings nav (General, Accounts, Businesses, Notifications, Rules, Spaces & sharing), tags chip list, hierarchical category table with Type and Tax Form columns

Quicken Simplifi mobile notification settings: per-alert toggle list (high credit card balance, income received, large transaction, low balance, monthly summary, refund status, uncategorized transactions) with channel labels Email/Push/In app
Quicken Simplifi transaction export: 5 transactions selected with running total and the download/export-to-CSV icon highlighted in the register toolbar
Rocket Money mobile New Category form (name, color, icon, tax-deductible flag) with 'Select a Category Group' sheet: Expenses / Earnings / Ignored semantics
Rocket Money linked-institution management: Bank of America group (last synced, Add Account, Unlink) with account rows by type, Apple Card with Import Statement action, Add Institution CTA
Plaid Link return handoff inside Rocket Money's connect flow: cdn.plaid.com browser sheet 'Continue to Rocket Money to finish account linking' with Continue button
